pages.title: Unstable Zones
pages.text: Unstable zones in the Overworld contain random blocks and anomalous changes. They are useful places to find ghost mobs and related materials.$(br2)Watch the first-visit messages and Herobrine's reaction. He may intervene to handle anomalies; inspect threats and terrain before gathering.

pages.title: Enter the End Ring
pages.text: Seek an Eternal Key in places such as stronghold libraries, End Cities and Ancient Cities. A Glitch Echo called with a Memory Shard and jukebox can offer clues.$(br2)Use the key on bedrock in the End. Visiting the End Ring advances the relevant records and unlocks the panel's protection feature.

pages.title: Return Home
pages.text: The End Ring hosts story and challenges. Follow the prompts and interact with Herobrine. Once the story reaches the return stage, gaze upward for about 10 seconds to return.$(br2)Return depends on story progress in this Java edition. Challenges have their own session rules.
